initialization_and_cleanup_obligations.description: Compact payloads are bounded, checksum-verified, expanded to canonical .nwp bytes, and validated by the existing decoder before any GPU resource or pipeline is created.
The MSZIP decoder uses the Windows inbox Compression API; clean-system startup and dependency verification remain pending on the exact target.
CFG, NX, ASLR, CET, and stack cookies remain enabled; no mitigation was disabled to reduce bytes.

measurements.notes: Contract-only structural DXIL measurement using the canonical NW-07 graph/export path recorded 4,475 bytes complete distribution versus 18,008 bytes canonical (4,093-byte MSZIP container versus 17,626-byte package). The exact Windows x64 release artifact, decoder code contribution, clean-system startup, and physical frame-time evidence remain pending; those contract-only bytes are not release evidence.

diagnostics.summary: The existing Windows inbox MSZIP decompressor was selected for the contract-only compact payload because it was smaller than stored, zlib, bzip2, and lzma candidates after complete-container overhead.
diagnostics.preservation_statement: The contract-only numbers and the pending physical status are retained together; the experiment is never presented as physical 64 KiB proof.
